# Hanginggardens audio credits

Every sound in this folder is cut from a field or foley recording that its author released into the public domain.
No attribution is required for any of them; the authors are credited here with thanks.
`tools/hanginggardens-audio.json` holds the exact excerpt and processing of each file, and `tools/place-audio.py --set hanginggardens` rebuilds them.

## Files

- `water.mp3` is cut from "Water flowing in north of Argentina (close to Salta)" by felix.blume, released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://freesound.org/people/felix.blume/sounds/234240/.
- `birds.mp3` is cut from "chirping_Parakeets_and_cooing_Pigeons.wav" by Framefive, released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://freesound.org/people/Framefive/sounds/128068/.
- `leaves.mp3` is cut from "Forest, close up of trees rustling in the wind.wav" by Anya_Media, released under CC0 1.0 Universal (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), from https://freesound.org/people/Anya_Media/sounds/523389/.
